title: Turbulent Dynamos on Bounded Domains and Their Generalization to the Geometric Transport Equation
summary: For any smooth bounded domain $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^3$, we construct a divergence-free velocity field $u \in L_t^1 W^{1,p}(Ω)$ for all $p < \infty$, and magnetic fields $B^ε\in L_t^p C^{m}(Ω)$ for all $p < \infty$ and $m\in \mathbb{N}$, that solve the kinematic dynamo equation and exhibit arbitrarily fast growth of any magnetic energy mode, uniformly in the vanishing-diffusivity limit $ε\to 0$.
